{{Quote|Look out, Arrow Nine, you've got two on your&mdash;|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to Stinger|<ref name="gambit" />}}
'''Stinger''', who flew under the callsign "'''Arrow Nine'''," was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in [[Arrow Squadron]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]], under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and the Republic, Stinger participated in a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] against Separatist forces in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. As Stinger [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engaged]] tiers of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was shot down by one of the Vultures, resulting in the [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] [[Death/Legends|death]].

==Biography==
Stinger was the nickname of one<ref name="gambit" /> of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Like his fellow clones, Stinger was bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="databank" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="annual" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Stinger was part of the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Arrow Squadron]], and flew under the callsign "Arrow Nine." Under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the squadron was stationed aboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|''Indomitable'']] when the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to which it was assigned received the order to defend the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] from an attack by the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Stinger participated in the following [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] against Separatist forces. The defense of the planet proved even more difficult than expected due to [[Grievous's computer virus]], which [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] all communications for the Republic, albeit leaving internal [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|helmet]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] unaffected.<ref name="gambit" />

Under Skywalker's command, Stinger and Arrow Squadron boarded their starfighters to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|engage]] tiers of Separatist [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]]. During the attack, Stinger was pursued by several Vultures and was unable to evade them. As Skywalker made his way toward Stinger to help him, the clone's fighter was shot down by one of the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid fighters]], resulting in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Stinger.<ref name="gambit" />

==Personality and traits==
Stinger was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]]<ref name="gambit" /> who stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|standard meters]] tall.<ref name="databank" /> When Stinger died, he briefly felt pain and anger. Skywalker experienced this through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="gambit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stinger was first mentioned in a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', which was written by [[Wikipedia:Australians|Australian]] [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Miller]] and released on [[February 23]], [[2010]]. In the novel, Stinger's death is mentioned during a [[Space warfare/Legends|space battle]] from Anakin Skywalker's point of view.<ref name="gambit" />
